title: Engineering the NAMC National Event Portal
summaryLead: The NAMC Event Portal was custom-engineered to support the National Association of Minority Contractors (NAMC) as the digital flagship for major national gatherings, including the 58th Annual National Conference.
summaryMore: Designed and built on a high-performance composable architecture hosted on Netlify, the portal delivers very fast page loads, a secure setup and dynamic event management, keeping things running smoothly through peak registration and sponsorship cycles.

stack.name: Hosting
stack.detail: Netlify Edge: global CDN distribution, static asset optimisation and fast time to first byte.

stack.name: Architecture
stack.detail: Composable, static-first: pre-built static pages served from the edge, with no server rendering and no database dependency.

stack.name: Markup and accessibility
stack.detail: HTML5 structured to WCAG 2.1 AA, with keyboard navigation and screen-reader support.

stack.name: Styling
stack.detail: Modern CSS3 with Grid, a fluid typography scale and design tokens as custom properties.

stack.name: Agenda
stack.detail: A native CSS Grid schedule layout built for scanning on a phone.

stack.name: Calendar sync
stack.detail: Lightweight .ics (iCalendar) file generation, so attendees can add a single session or a whole track to Apple, Google or Outlook calendars.

stack.name: Sponsorship workflow
stack.detail: Serverless form endpoints and edge routing handle tier selection and details, validate uploads of vector assets, and send notifications to the admin team.

stack.name: Payments
stack.detail: Payment gateway routing for sponsorship and registration.

stack.name: Performance
stack.detail: A zero-dependency front-end core aimed at top Lighthouse scores for Performance, Accessibility and Best Practices.

chapters.title: High-performance composable architecture
chapters.challenge: Delivering real-time event updates, agenda details and sponsor displays to thousands of concurrent visitors without latency or the risk of server overload during peak conference announcements.
chapters.solution: A static-first build pipeline mapped directly to Netlify's global edge network. Static assets are served from the edge nodes closest to the user, bypassing traditional server-side rendering delays.
chapters.outcome: Instantaneous load times, near-zero time to first byte, and resistance to traffic spikes.

chapters.title: Multi-tiered sponsorship and asset workflows
chapters.challenge: Letting sponsors select tiers, submit details and upload high-resolution vector assets securely, while streamlining administrative routing.
chapters.solution: Serverless form endpoints and edge routing logic process incoming sponsorship applications, validate uploads and route notifications instantly to the administrative team.
chapters.outcome: A frictionless onboarding flow for corporate sponsors, paired with automated back-end handling.

chapters.title: Interactive schedule and calendar integration
chapters.challenge: Giving attendees a mobile-optimised, scannable event schedule that lets them sync to their calendar instantly on any device.
chapters.solution: A native CSS Grid agenda layout coupled with lightweight .ics file generation and calendar integration, so people can add single sessions or whole tracks to Apple, Google or Outlook calendars.
chapters.outcome: High mobile usability and real-time schedule access for attendees on site.

results.title: Speed and scalability
results.text: Sub-second load times globally, with zero database dependency overhead.

results.title: Accessibility
results.text: Built to WCAG 2.1 standards, for full screen-reader compatibility and keyboard navigation.

results.title: Operational efficiency
results.text: Streamlined sponsor sign-ups and ticket management reduced manual administrative work during event preparation.
